scope: All lua-table and multi-result routes in the exact script API pattern ledger, including generated fixed tuples
evidencePolicy: Planning/schema classification only. This artifact does not claim compilation, linkage, packaged-engine execution, or runtime behavior.

buckets.name: flat-record
buckets.description: Fixed-field records whose fields are scalar, enum, hash, URL, or copied Defold values.

buckets.name: fixed-scalar-tuple
buckets.description: Fixed-arity tuples containing only scalar, enum, and nullable scalar slots.

buckets.name: fixed-value-tuple
buckets.description: Fixed-arity tuples containing copied Defold values such as vectors and quaternions.

buckets.name: typed-sequence
buckets.description: Arrays or records containing arrays with mechanically known element codecs but no IR size bound.

buckets.name: typed-map
buckets.description: Maps with mechanically known key/value codecs but no IR entry bound or coercion policy.

buckets.name: table-tuple-schema
buckets.description: Fixed tuples with at least one table input or result that requires a bounded table schema.

buckets.name: tagged-table-union
buckets.description: A table participates in a non-null union and requires an explicit branch discriminator.

buckets.name: opaque-record
buckets.description: A record contains an opaque or unresolved nested value such as a render constant buffer.

buckets.name: semantic-flat-record
buckets.description: A structurally flat record whose discriminator, binary data, or ownership semantics are not in the IR shape.

buckets.name: owned-handle-tuple
buckets.description: A fixed tuple returning owned Lua userdata whose close and registry lifetime must be explicit.

buckets.name: binary-string-tuple
buckets.description: A fixed tuple containing a Lua byte string that cannot use a generic UTF-16 JavaScript string codec.

buckets.name: dynamic-recursive
buckets.description: Recursive or any-valued tables requiring cycle, depth, size, and supported-value policies.
